en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 200 - Muhammad Ibn Yaqub Kulaini has directly narrated from Nasim, maidservant of Imam Hasan Askari (a.s) that she said:

“When I came to him on the tenth night after his birth and sneezed in his presence, the Master of the Age (a.s) said, ‘May Allah have mercy on you.’ I became very happy; he said, ‘May I not give you glad tidings about sneezing?’ I said: ‘Please do.’ He said: ‘It is protection from death for three days.”
